laws.rule: Sept-Îles National Nature Reserve (off Perros-Guirec, Côtes-d'Armor), extended by decree 2023-640 to about 19,700 ha of sea and islands: landing is allowed all year on Île aux Moines, using the paths only, and from 15 July to 30 September on the sand beach at the south of Île Bono for beach and picnic use; the reserve map marks which other islands and shores are closed to landing. All activity is prohibited in the reinforced protection zone around Île Rouzic from 1 April to 31 August. Landing dogs, bivouac, fires, taking animals, plants or pebbles, and dropping rubbish are prohibited across the reserve. Flying a drone over the reserve is prohibited. Motorised watercraft such as jet skis and towed devices such as tubes and water skis are prohibited. Foot fishing is allowed within 3 hours either side of low tide, except on Rouzic and Malban.
